  • Constructor Details

    • TuiConfig

      public TuiConfig(boolean rawMode, boolean alternateScreen, boolean hideCursor, boolean mouseCapture, boolean bracketedPaste, Duration pollTimeout, Duration tickRate, Duration resizeGracePeriod, boolean shutdownHook, Bindings bindings, RenderErrorHandler errorHandler, PrintStream errorOutput, boolean fpsOverlayEnabled, List<PostRenderProcessor> postRenderProcessors, Backend backend, ScheduledExecutorService scheduler)
      Creates a new TUI configuration with the specified options.

      Prefer using builder() or defaults() instead of this constructor.

      Parameters:
      rawMode - whether to enable raw terminal mode
      alternateScreen - whether to use the alternate screen buffer
      hideCursor - whether to hide the cursor
      mouseCapture - whether to capture mouse events
      bracketedPaste - whether to enable bracketed paste mode
      pollTimeout - timeout for polling events
      tickRate - interval between tick events, or null to disable
      resizeGracePeriod - grace period for resize events, or null to disable
      shutdownHook - whether to register a JVM shutdown hook
      bindings - the key/mouse bindings for semantic actions
      errorHandler - the handler for render errors
      errorOutput - the output stream for error logging
      fpsOverlayEnabled - whether to show the FPS overlay
      postRenderProcessors - list of post-render processors
      backend - the backend to use (optional)
      scheduler - external scheduler to use, or null to create an internal one

  • Method Details

    • defaults

      public static TuiConfig defaults()
      Returns the default configuration.

      By default, tick events are generated every 100ms to ensure periodic UI refresh. Use TuiConfig.Builder.noTick() to disable automatic ticking.

      Returns:
      the default TUI configuration

    • withAnimation

      public static TuiConfig withAnimation(Duration tickRate)
      Returns a configuration suitable for animated applications.
      Parameters:
      tickRate - the interval between tick events (e.g., Duration.ofMillis(16) for ~60fps)
      Returns:
      configuration with ticks enabled

    • bracketedPaste

      public boolean bracketedPaste()
      Returns whether bracketed paste mode is enabled.

      When enabled, pasted text containing control characters such as Tab is delivered as a single PasteEvent rather than individual key events. Disabled by default.

      Returns:
      true if bracketed paste mode is enabled

    • resizeGracePeriod

      public Duration resizeGracePeriod()
      Returns the resize grace period.

      This defines the maximum time before resize events are processed, ensuring the UI redraws promptly on terminal resize even when ticks are disabled or have a long interval.

      Returns:
      the resize grace period, or null to use the poll timeout

      public List<PostRenderProcessor> postRenderProcessors()

      Processors are called in order after the main renderer completes.

    • backend

      public Backend backend()
      Returns the configured backend, or null if not set.

      If null, a backend will be created using BackendFactory.create() when the TUI is started.

      Returns:
      the configured backend, or null

    • scheduler

      public ScheduledExecutorService scheduler()
      Returns the externally-managed scheduler, or null if the runner should create its own.

      When an external scheduler is provided, the runner will NOT shut it down on close - the caller retains ownership and is responsible for its lifecycle.

      Returns:
      the external scheduler, or null to use an internally-managed one
